noCollectionsHint: This Icons8 account has no collections available for sync.
notConfigured: Icons8 Authorization is not configured. Please fill it in and verify on the Settings tab first.

tokenPlaceholder: Paste the Icons8 Authorization (Bearer prefix allowed)

autoLoginRunningHint: Fetching your Icons8 credential from local Firefox…
autoLoginSaveOk: Credential fetched from Firefox and saved
